item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code performance dashboard
item.description:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now has a public preview query performance dashboard. It uses Query Store to show performance insights, trend analysis, execution plans, and query optimization with GitHub Copilot.

  • Source: Azure Updates
